Annotation Interface Command

@Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target({METHOD,FIELD}) public @interface Command
Declares a command: its handler is the annotated method, a non-private, non-static method returning void or Task<?>, that takes no parameter or a single CommandContext. It is called on the EDT.

On a field, it declares a toggle with no handler: the field is a non-private, non-static Property<Boolean>, which activating the command flips, and which the command's selected state follows. The id defaults to the field's name, and names the command's method in the generated class. Such a command takes no selected() and no block(); annotating any other field is a compile error. Generated code reads the field, which needs no Exposed: be.imgn.swing.ui.Command joins the annotations that Checkstyle's VisibilityModifier accepts, as Exposed does.

The processor generates a <Class>Commands bean for each class that declares commands, with one method per command that returns its BoundCommand. Text, icon, shortcut and tooltip come from the class's resources, under [commands.<id>].
